title: Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale
instructions: Clinician-rated examination for abnormal involuntary movements, including activation maneuvers and dental status.

score.missing_response_policy: unanswered items score 0 in the current runtime; complete examination is required for interpretation

items.text: Current Problems with Teeth and/or Dentures

screening_rules.label: Tardive Dyskinesia Screen
screening_rules.criterion_label: Schooler–Kane: ≥2 in two areas or ≥3 in one

severity_bands.label: No movements rated (0)
severity_bands.action: No scored abnormal movements on items 1-7

severity_bands.label: Total 1–7 (descriptive)
severity_bands.action: Descriptive total only (AIMS has no validated total-score severity bands); use the Schooler–Kane screen and global item 8 for severity

severity_bands.label: Total 8–14 (descriptive)
severity_bands.action: Descriptive total only; use the Schooler–Kane screen and global item 8 for severity. Review medication exposure and functional impact

severity_bands.label: Total 15–21 (descriptive)
severity_bands.action: Descriptive total only; use the Schooler–Kane screen and global item 8 for severity. Consider treatment modification or specialist input

severity_bands.label: Total 22–28 (descriptive)
severity_bands.action: Descriptive total only; use the Schooler–Kane screen and global item 8 for severity. Assess safety, impairment, and treatment urgency

report.heading: Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale (AIMS)
report.scoring_note: Scoring: total movement score is the sum of items 1-7 (0-28). AIMS has no validated total-score severity bands; total-score bands shown here are descriptive only. Severity comes from the Schooler–Kane screen and global item 8. Items 8-10 are global judgments; items 11-12 document dental status.
report.screening_note: Positive TD screen uses the Schooler–Kane criterion: a rating of 2 (mild) or higher in at least two body areas (items 1-7), or 3 (moderate) or higher in at least one area. Global item 8 is reported but does not count toward the screen by itself.
